summary.zh: 信任度代表学生对玩家阵营的认可程度。它决定学生是否愿意加入组织，也会影响顶部稳定度、区域支持率与行动结果。
summary.en: Trust represents how much a student accepts the player's faction. It affects recruitment, faction stability, regional support, and action outcomes.

items.zh: 每名学生都有独立的信任度。
items.en: Every student has an individual trust value.

items.zh: 未加入组织的学生信任度会影响学生支持率。
items.en: Trust from students outside the organization affects student support.

items.zh: 已加入组织的成员信任度会影响组织稳定度。
items.en: Trust from organization members affects faction stability.

items.zh: 同一区域内学生的平均信任度会形成该地块的支持率。
items.en: The average trust of students in a province becomes that province's support rate.

items.zh: 信任度过低时，学生无法被邀请加入。
items.en: Students with very low trust cannot be invited.

items.zh: 信任度越高，手动邀请成功率越高。
items.en: Higher trust improves manual invitation success.

items.zh: 高信任度学生在组织知名度足够时，可能主动发送加入申请。
items.en: Highly trusting students may request to join once faction fame is high enough.

items.zh: 邀请失败过多会降低全体学生对玩家阵营的信任。
items.en: Too many failed invitations can reduce trust across the student body.

items.zh: 成员压力崩溃、退出组织或错误决策可能导致信任度下降。
items.en: Stress breakdowns, member departures, and poor decisions can reduce trust.

items.zh: 管理层支持者通常更难建立高信任关系。
items.en: Faculty supporters are usually harder to build trust with.
